# LibreOffice Impress GUI Interface Description

## System and Application Header
- **Operating System**: Linux (indicated by Activities button and dock)
- **Application**: LibreOffice Impress
- **Window Title**: "ASIST-Strategic-Plan-Town-Hall.pptx - LibreOffice Impress"
- **Date and Time**: "Oct 22 23:13" displayed in the top bar
- **System Tray Icons**: Present on the top-right corner (including sound, network, and system status icons)

## Application Menu Bar
- **Menu Items**: File, Edit, View, Insert, Format, Slide, Slide Show, Tools, Window, Help
- **Active Menu**: "Format" menu is currently open, displaying a dropdown list of formatting options

## Format Menu Dropdown
- **Menu Items**:
  - Text
  - Spacing
  - Align Text
  - Lists
  - Clear Direct Formatting (with keyboard shortcut: Shift+Ctrl+M)
  - Styles
  - Character...
  - Paragraph...
  - Bullets and Numbering...
  - Table
  - Image
  - Object and Shape
  - Shadow
  - Interaction...
  - Name...
  - Description...
  - Distribute Selection
  - Rotate
  - Flip
  - Convert
  - Align Objects
  - Arrange
  - Group

## Toolbar
- **Icons**: A row of icons for common functions including:
  - File operations
  - Drawing tools
  - Text formatting
  - Slide layout tools
  - Object manipulation
  - Slide show controls
  - Special characters and symbols
  - Font and color tools
  - Shape and diagram tools
  - Alignment and spacing tools
  - Object grouping and distribution tools

## Slide Navigation Panel
- **Location**: Left side of the interface
- **Content**: A vertical list of slide thumbnails
- **Slide Numbers**: 7 through 15 are visible
- **Slide Titles**: Each thumbnail displays the title of the slide
  - Slide 7: "DISCUSSING THE STRATEGIC PLAN"
  - Slide 8: "5 STRATEGIC DIRECTIONS"
  - Slide 9: "1. MEMBERSHIP"
  - Slide 10: "2. PROGRAMS/SERVICES/MENTORING"
  - Slide 11: "PUBLICATIONS/COMMUNICATIONS/OCAL MEDIA"
  - Slide 12: "4. PUBLICITY/OUTREACH/ADVOCACY"
  - Slide 13: "5. INSTITUTIONAL KNOWLEDGE"
  - Slide 14: "QUESTIONS FOR YOU"
  - Slide 15: "ASIST MISSION STATEMENT"
- **Current Slide**: Slide 1 of 18 (indicated at the bottom of the panel)

## Main Slide Area
- **Slide Title**: "ASIS&T STRATEGIC PLANNING TOWN HALL MEETING"
- **Subtitle**: "SEPTEMBER 29 and OCTOBER 1, 2015"
- **Footer**: "asis&t" logo with text "Association for Information Science and Technology" below it
- **Slide Layout**: Title slide with large text at the top and a logo at the bottom
- **Selected Element**: The title text is highlighted in blue, indicating it is selected for editing

## Properties Panel
- **Location**: Right side of the interface
- **Panel Sections**:
  - **Slide Properties**:
    - Format: "Widescreen"
    - Orientation: "Landscape"
    - Background: "None" (with "Insert Image..." button)
    - Master Slide: "Title Slide"
    - Master Background: Checked
    - Master Objects: Checked
    - Master View: Button available
  - **Layouts**:
    - A grid of layout thumbnails
    - One layout is highlighted with a red border
    - Layouts include various combinations of title and content areas

## Status Bar
- **Location**: Bottom of the interface
- **Information**:
  - "Slide 1 of 18"
  - "Title Slide"
  - Coordinates: "-0.12 / -6.87" and "0.00 x 0.00"
  - Zoom level: "92%"
  - Language: "English (USA)"

## Dock Icons
- **Location**: Left side of the screen
- **Icons**: A vertical dock with application icons including:
  - Activities
  - Web browser (Chrome)
  - Email client
  - Code editor (VS Code)
  - Media player (VLC)
  - Document editor (LibreOffice Writer)
  - Spreadsheet (LibreOffice Calc)
  - Presentation (LibreOffice Impress)
  - Image editor (GIMP)
  - File manager
  - Software
